detail.readme:
Your code is ready. Let Sealos ship it.

A desktop Ops Agent for deploying and running full-stack apps.
Local code, cloud infrastructure, and ongoing operations — in one project.

Documentation · 简体中文

Deployment walkthrough from the Sealos homepage. Click the image for full resolution; explore the interactive demo.

## Meet Sealos Desktop Turn a local folder, a GitHub repository, a container image, or an application template into a running service. Describe what the project needs; the built-in agent handles the deployment workflow and connects the supporting resources. The desktop app connects your local development workflow to Sealos Cloud. Your services run in the cloud region you choose, and stay available when you close the desktop app. ### From local code to a public URL Bring the project you already have, including code written with AI tools. Sealos analyzes the application, builds its image, provisions dependencies and deploys it with a public HTTPS endpoint. Databases and application configuration stay alongside the service they support.

### Keep the whole project in view See how your app and its dependencies fit together. Inspect deployments, connection details, resource usage and service health from the project view; open logs or a container terminal when you need to investigate.

### Ask your Ops Agent when something breaks Investigate failed deployments, restarts, 502 errors and memory limits with the context of the whole project. The agent uses logs and metrics to explain the issue and propose a fix. Review change plans before execution, check the result and roll back a deployment when needed.

## Everything the app depends on | Resource | What Sealos brings together | | --- | --- | | **App hosting** | Deploy local projects, GitHub repositories, container images and ready-to-run templates. | | **Databases & cache** | PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB and Redis, with application connection configuration and daily backups. | | **Object storage** | S3-compatible buckets for uploads, assets and shared files. | | **AI Gateway** | Model access through a unified endpoint and API key, managed from your workspace. | | **Operations** | Logs, metrics, deployment history, rollback, scaling and agent-assisted troubleshooting. | | **Team workspaces** | Shared projects and resources, with individual member credentials. | Kubernetes powers the platform underneath. Apps use standard container images and databases use familiar engines, so your deployment remains portable. ## Get started 1. **[Download Sealos Desktop](https://github.com/sealox/sealox-releases/releases/latest)** for macOS or Windows, install it and sign in. 2. **Bring a project.** Open a local folder, paste a GitHub URL, deploy a container image, or pick a template such as Dify, n8n, WordPress or Open WebUI. 3. **Describe the outcome.** For example: “Deploy this project with PostgreSQL and Redis.” 4. **Review and deploy.** Approve the plan, open your public URL, then use the same project to monitor and maintain the stack. [Explore the live product demo](https://sealos.io/) · [Read the docs](https://sealos.io/docs) ## 🏘️ Community & support - 🌐 Visit the [Sealos Website](https://sealos.io/) for full documentation and useful links. - 💬 Join our [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/wdUn538zVP) to chat with the Sealos team and other Sealos users. This is a good place to learn about Sealos and Kubernetes, ask questions, and share your experiences. - 🐦 Tweet at @Sealos_io on [X/Twitter](https://twitter.com/Sealos_io) and follow us. - 🐞 Create [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/labring/sealos/issues/new/choose) for bug reports and feature requests. ## 🚧 Roadmap Sealos maintains a [public roadmap](https://github.com/orgs/labring/projects/4/views/9). It gives a high-level view of the main priorities for the project, the maturity of different features and projects, and how to influence the project direction. ## 👩‍💻 Contributing & Development Have a look through [existing issues](https://github.com/labring/sealos/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+sort%3Aupdated-desc) and [Pull Requests](https://github.com/labring/sealos/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+sort%3Aupdated-desc) that you could help with. If you'd like to request a feature or report a bug, please [create a GitHub Issue](https://github.com/labring/sealos/issues/new/choose) using one of the templates provided. 📖 [See contribution guide →](./CONTRIBUTING.md) 🔧 [See development guide →](./DEVELOPGUIDE.md) ## Links - [FastGPT](https://github.com/labring/FastGPT) is a free, open-source, and powerful AI knowledge base platform, offers out-of-the-box data processing, model invocation, RAG retrieval, and visual AI workflows. Easily build complex LLM applications. - [Buildah](https://github.com/containers/buildah) The functionalities of Buildah are extensively utilized in Sealos 4.0 to ensure that cluster images are compatible with OCI standard. [deploy-badge]: https://sealos.io/Deploy-on-Sealos.svg [deploy-link]: https://os.sealos.io ## 📄 License Sealos is licensed under the [Sealos Sustainable Use License](./LICENSE.md), a custom license that allows: - ✅ Internal business use and personal non-commercial use - ❌ Providing cloud services to third parties **Not a standard open source license** - please review the [full license terms](./LICENSE.md) before use. **Contributing**: By contributing, you agree to our [Contributor License Agreement](./CONTRIBUTOR_LICENSE_AGREEMENT.md) and license change terms.
detail.readme_zh:
代码写好了，让 Sealos 帮你上线。

专注于应用上线与持续运维的桌面 Agent。
从本地代码到云端运行，把应用和依赖放在同一个项目里管理。

文档 · English

国际版官网部署演示。点击图片查看原尺寸；体验完整交互。

## 认识 Sealos Desktop 用 AI 写完代码后，下一步是让项目真正运行起来。Sealos Desktop 内置面向部署与运维的 Agent：理解项目、构建镜像、创建依赖、发布服务，并协助你处理上线之后的问题。 本地目录、GitHub 仓库、容器镜像和应用模板，都可以作为起点。应用、数据库、缓存、对象存储和模型访问配置，在同一个项目中完成交付和管理。 ### 为什么是桌面版？ - **承接本地开发。** 直接选择电脑上的源码目录，将本地开发或 AI 工具生成的项目交给 Agent 部署。 - **内置专用 Agent。** 用自然语言描述上线和运维需求，由 Agent 结合项目与云端资源执行工作流。 - **依赖一起交付。** 创建应用所需的数据库、缓存、存储和模型密钥，并配置应用与资源之间的连接。 桌面版是控制中心，线上服务运行在你选择的 Sealos Cloud 区域；关闭客户端后，服务仍在云端运行。 以下界面来自国际版官网演示，文字与图标均按高像素密度重新截取。 ## 从源代码到线上服务 选择项目并描述目标，例如：“部署这个项目，使用 PostgreSQL 保存数据、Redis 管理会话。”Agent 分析项目，完成构建、依赖配置与云端部署，最终交付可访问的公网链接。

## 上线之后，继续交给 Agent 协助运维 构建失败、容器重启、异常日志、数据库连接故障，都可以在项目上下文中直接提问。Agent 分析原因并给出修复方案；需要确认的变更通过计划呈现，执行后继续检查结果。 下图展示了国际版的项目日志视图：数据库异常退出后，应用出现连接失败与 502 错误。结合日志、状态和指标，可以向 Agent 发起诊断。

## 用资源拓扑理解整个项目 应用、数据库和缓存之间的关系集中展示。查看服务状态和资源连接，进入部署记录、日志、监控与环境变量，排查问题时保留完整的项目上下文。

## 应用需要的基础设施，在一个工作空间里 | 能力 | 可以做什么 | | --- | --- | | **应用托管** | 部署本地项目、GitHub 仓库、容器镜像，或使用 Dify、n8n、WordPress、Open WebUI 等模板。 | | **数据库与缓存** | 创建 PostgreSQL、MySQL、MongoDB、Redis，配置应用连接，并使用每日备份。 | | **对象存储** | 使用兼容 S3 的存储桶管理上传文件、静态资源和共享文件。 | | **AI 网关** | 通过统一端点和 API Key 接入模型服务，在工作空间中管理访问配置。 | | **持续运维** | 查看日志与指标、诊断故障、调整资源、管理部署历史和回滚。 | | **团队协作** | 在共享工作空间中管理项目与资源，每位成员使用自己的凭据。 | Sealos 底层由 Kubernetes 驱动，应用采用标准容器镜像，数据库使用通用引擎，方便后续迁移与扩展。 ## 开始使用 1. **[下载 Sealos Desktop](https://sealos.cn/downloads)**，选择 macOS 或 Windows 安装包，安装后登录。 2. **选择项目来源**：本地目录、GitHub 仓库、容器镜像或应用模板。 3. **描述上线需求**，查看 Agent 给出的执行计划并确认。 4. **打开线上链接**，在同一项目中继续查看状态、管理资源和排查问题。 [体验完整产品演示](https://sealos.cn/downloads) · [阅读文档](https://sealos.cn/docs) ## 🏘️ 社区与支持 - 🌐 访问 [Sealos官网](https://sealos.io/) 获取完整的文档和实用链接。 - 💬 加入我们的 [Discord服务器](https://discord.gg/qzBmGGZGk7)，与 Sealos 开发者和终端用户进行交流。这是了解 Sealos 和 Kubernetes 以及提问和分享经验的理想之地。 - 🐦 在 [Twitter](https://twitter.com/Sealos_io) 上关注我们。 - 🐞 请将任何 Sealos 的 Bug、问题和需求提交到 [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/labring/sealos/issues/new/choose)。 ## 🚧 发展规划 Sealos 维护了一个[公开的发展路线图](https://github.com/orgs/labring/projects/4/views/9)，为项目的主要优先事项、不同功能和项目的成熟度，以及如何影响项目方向提供了高级视图。 ## 👩‍💻 贡献与开发 翻阅[现有的 Issue](https://github.com/labring/sealos/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+sort%3Aupdated-desc) 和 [Pull Requests](https://github.com/labring/sealos/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+sort%3Aupdated-desc)，看看您是否能提供帮助。如果您想要新增需求或报告 Bug，请使用我们提供的模板[创建一个 GitHub Issue](https://github.com/labring/sealos/issues/new/choose)。 📖 [查看贡献指南 →](./CONTRIBUTING.md) 🔧 [查看开发指南 →](./DEVELOPGUIDE.md) ## 🔗 链接 - [Laf](https://github.com/labring/laf) 是 Sealos 上的一款函数计算应用，让写代码像写博客一样简单，随时随地发布上线。 - [Buildah](https://github.com/containers/buildah) 在 Sealos 4.0 中，我们广泛地利用了 Buildah 的能力，以确保集群镜像与 OCI 标准兼容。 ## 📄 许可证 Sealos 采用 [Sealos 可持续使用许可证](./LICENSE.md)，这是一个定制许可证，允许： - ✅ 内部商业用途和个人非商业用途 - ❌ 向第三方提供云服务 **这不是标准的开源许可证** - 使用前请查看 [完整许可证条款](./LICENSE.md)。 **贡献代码**: 通过贡献代码，您同意我们的 [贡献者许可协议](./CONTRIBUTOR_LICENSE_AGREEMENT.md) 和许可证变更条款。
